title: Migrate a constructor-binding consumer to binding selection
goal: Replace a removed constructor-binding call and verify scalar and service parameters plus invalid bindings on the actual provider.

selectionNotes: EF10 TryBindConstructor accepts a specific ConstructorInfo and reports false plus unbound parameters. EF11 removes it; GetBindings selects constructor and service-only bindings for the type and throws for an unbindable type. GetBindings already exists in EF10 and is a valid earlier migration. It is not a drop-in replacement for arbitrary constructor preference: this bounded consumer has one constructor with two mapped scalar parameters and an injected DbContext. Preserve custom selection requirements before choosing this route. An original Bird is inserted with SQL and materialized in a fresh context, verifying scalar values and injected context identity. Independent mutable metadata checks the public factory and invalid Uri unknown parameter. Factory inspection does not itself install a custom factory or change EF conventions. The example consumes the public extension contract and never subclasses internal EF implementations. No lazy-loading, arbitrary service injection or generic object mapper is promised.
